items.headline: [Materials] Albemarle Rises on Earnings as Global Lithium Demand Grows Faster Than Expected - US Stock Individual
items.snippet: Albemarle, a chemical company specializing in lithium and other products, is rising after exceeding expectations for both earnings per share and sales in Q2. Global lithium demand is expanding at a pace exceeding its expectations, outpacing supply growth.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Q2 2026 Earnings Call on Aug 6, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Global lithium consumption was up 45% year-over-year through May, tracking above our forecasted range, driven by continued strength in stationary storage and improving growth in electric vehicles.

items.headline: ALBEMARLE CORP files FORM 10-Q for Q2, FY 2026 on Aug 5, 2026
items.snippet: Energy Storage net sales and profitability are strongly dependent on lithium market prices, which are volatile. Global EV and ESS sales are expected to increase over the prior year, driving sustained demand for lithium batteries.

items.headline: Here's How to Play Albemarle Stock Before Q2 Earnings Release
items.snippet: Falling lithium market prices are weighing on ALB stock. ALB's shares are down 16.1% year to date, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry's 17.6% increase and the S&P 500's rise of 9.5%.

items.headline: Albemarle Stock Loses 25% in a Month: What Should Investors Do Now?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 25.5% in the past month on falling lithium market prices amid slowing EV demand in China, an inventory glut, and prospects of increased supply from mine restarts.
